{{Quote|What are we going to do? R2 and C-3PO have not returned with the jogan fruit for the cake.|Baker droid to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Evil Plans">{{TCW|Evil Plans}}</ref>}}
This '''baker droid''' was employed by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] to cater a function in honor of Senator [[Aang/Legends|Aang]], whom she was trying to sway as the deciding vote on a bill she hoped to pass in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]. The droid shared the same design as a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]].

The event hinged on the creation of a [[Jogan fruitcake/Legends|jogan fruitcake]], which was the favorite dessert of the [[Roonan/Legends|Roonan]] senator. When [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] were sent to buy the jogan for the cake and had not returned, the [[Baker droid/Legends|droid]] was worried. However, they finally returned with the fruit. He, with the help of several [[LEP servant droid/Legends|LEP servant droids]], placed the finishing touches on the cake and brought it out to the dining table.

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The baker droid is portrayed by celebrity chef [[Jeffrey Goldman|Duff Goldman]].
Its model seems to be related to the [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]].
